name: Soup & Broth

greeting: SOUP! Get your HOT SOUP here!
Soup and Broth! At your service! I'm Soup! He's Broth!
Warmth in a bowl! Only in Frost!
New face! Frozen face! We can FIX that! With SOUP!
The white uniforms mean we're licensed! For soup! Important distinction!
Hot soup! Cold day! Perfect combination!
Soup: 'Welcome!' Broth: 'To our stand!' Both: 'BEST SOUP IN FROST!'
You're shivering! We have JUST the thing! It's... SOUP!
dialog.shop_open: Today's specials! Minestrone! Chowder! And Broth's experimental 'Mystery Steam!'
dialog.food_offer: Hot soup! Warms the body! Warms the SOUL! Probably!
haggle: Best we can do? Extra crackers! Unlimited! Within reason!
For heroes? Hero discount! 10%! Because you're SAVING us!
purchase_success: ENJOY! Don't burn your tongue! But burning means it's WORKING!
Excellent choice! That batch is PARTICULARLY steamy!
Come back when you're cold! Which should be ALWAYS!
purchase_fail: No coin? No PROBLEM! ...Wait, yes problem. Small problem.
Soup costs money! Steam costs COAL! We have COSTS!
Come back with WARM money! Cold coins are hard to count!
rumor: The hot springs are NATURAL! Probably! Maybe! Don't ask questions!
Cirrus the weather watcher? Always ordering the SPICIEST soup! Wants to FEEL something!
Azure the balloonist? Never eats. Just... stares at the sky. Sad.
The twins? Ice oracles? They drink our broth! For VISIONS! We don't ask.
That snake charmer's rock? Keeps his soup hot! ALL day! We want one!
dialog.quest_hook: Supply problem! Azure's grounded! No supplies! We're running LOW! Find him? Help him? For SOUP!
dialog.quest_active: Any word on Azure? We need those supplies! Specifically: POTATOES! And: HOPE!
dialog.quest_complete: Azure's flying! Supplies coming! You saved our STAND! Free soup! FOREVER! (Limit: reasonable amounts)
farewell: Stay WARM! Stay FED! Stay EXCELLENT!
Roll on back! Like a warm barrel!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning soup! For morning cold! Rise and SHINE! Or just rise!
dialog.time_noon: Midday rush! Lunch break! SOUP BREAK!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening soup! Sunset special! Romantic! If you like SOUP!
dialog.time_night: Night shift soup! For night workers! And the COLD-HEARTED!
dialog.rival_mention: Our blue counterparts? Ice fishing? COLD soup! Different market!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The SOUP SAVIOR! Azure's flying! Supplies flowing! Have a bowl! ON US!

party_reactions.kade: They're so... enthusiastic. About SOUP. It's infectious!
party_reactions.nix7: Nutritional analysis: Adequate. Thermal properties: Optimal. Service: Overwhelming.
party_reactions.twist: SOUP?! I LOVE SOUP! ALL THE SOUP! GIVE ME SOUP!
party_reactions.korr: Warmth shared freely. This is how communities survive.
party_reactions.renna: The soup has minor warming enchantments. Subtle. Effective.
party_reactions.suresh: They alleviate suffering through nourishment. Simple. Noble.
party_reactions.sova: I'd eat here. Good position. Clear sightlines. Hot food.
party_reactions.grit: Field kitchen quality. Which is high praise.
party_reactions.ashka: They understand heat. Proper application. I approve.
party_reactions.senna: They hear everything. Customers talk. Soup listens.
party_reactions.callum: Finally! Proper food safety standards! And ENTHUSIASM!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? First soup's on us! ...Not really! But WELCOME!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning customer! We have your REGULAR ready! ...Do you have a regular? You SHOULD!
relationship_dialog.friend: Soup FRIEND! We made you a SPECIAL BLEND! Secret recipe!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: SOULMATE! Through SOUP! Here! Our grandmother's ladle! Pass it on! To OTHER soup lovers!

mini_quest.title: The Soup Supply
mini_quest.description: Help Soup & Broth secure supply lines by getting Azure flying again

stages.hook: Azure's grounded! No balloon! No supplies! We're down to BROTH! Just BROTH! Find him! Help him! For CIVILIZATION!
stages.active: Lower peak! Balloon dock! His burner needs parts! Company store in Obsidian!
stages.complete: He's FLYING! Supplies INCOMING! You saved FROST! Free soup! FOR LIFE! (Terms and conditions apply!)

cross_npc_connections: aeronaut_blue_frost: Azure! Our SUPPLIER! Our HERO! Currently: GROUNDED!
foodboys_blue_frost: Our COLD counterparts! Ice fishers! Different philosophy! Same ENERGY!
pigman_white_frost: The innkeeper! Sometimes we TRADE! Soup for BEDS!
ironchef_industrial_obsidian: Our CULINARY rival! Steam-powered COOKING! Unconventional!
